rationale: This is a pure horizon re-parameterization of the archive leader (identical numerator/denominator with TS_SUM windows collapsed to one year), which is exactly the cosmetic-variant class the objective warns against, and the coverage gain is incidental rather than mechanistic.

target_name: Resource cover of capex and maturing debt
rationale: A defensible marginal refinement of the archive leader, but it adds a single-year stock (dlc) to a three-year flow sum, so the denominator mixes units and dlc's contribution is arbitrarily scaled down by the window length — precisely the reason it will look "capex-dominated" and likely just reproduce the parent signal.

target_name: Cash pile relative to investment requirement
rationale: Stripped of the cash-flow numerator this is cash holdings scaled by capital intensity, i.e. a close cousin of the well-documented cash-to-assets/cash-holdings return premium, and as an attribution exercise it is a decomposition of an existing archive signal rather than a new economic claim.

target_name: Resource cover of fixed and working capital investment
rationale: The denominator TS_SUM(capx + Δinvt, 3) is not sign-stable — inventory drawdowns can drive it toward zero or negative, flipping the ratio's sign for exactly the distressed/destocking firms the hypothesis cares about — and 1% winsorization will not repair that; the numerator also reverts to unadjusted cash earnings, undoing the accrual adjustment that generated the family's best evidence.

The change-in-coverage form is a genuinely distinct information set from the levels the archive has tested and the sign logic is coherent, though the two-thirds overlap between consecutive three-year windows means the delta is driven almost entirely by the entering and exiting years and may be dominated by noise.

target_name: Sales per dollar of operating capital
rationale: This is capital turnover, a standard DuPont component whose return predictability is already published (Soliman 2008; Novy-Marx-style profitability/turnover work), and in this raw un-industry-adjusted form it will mostly load on industry capital intensity rather than on the idle-capacity mechanism the reasoning invokes.
